name: vozclara
description: Multilingual AI study tool. Paste any public video URL to get a structured Knowledge Pack (summary, key ideas, glossary, quiz, transcript with timestamps) in Spanish, Portuguese, German, or English. Ships as an MCP server with one anonymous tool plus three OAuth-protected tools.
author: LeonMare

vozclara.description: Anonymous, free-tier. One composite tool: vozclara_generate_pack(url, language, depth).

vozclara-pro.description: OAuth-protected (PKCE S256). Tools: search_my_library, ask_video, export_anki. Scopes: library:read, library:write, profile.
